The Mahalanobis distance is used as a measure of multivariate dissimilarity in gene expression among species.",

    "No animal model sufficiently emulates human tenocytes’ cellular and molecular features and response to inflammation to be considered the gold-standard for tendon research.",
    "Peculiarities, strengths, and weaknesses of the model species need to be accounted for in the study design, analysis and interpretation."
